scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/finalize-build.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.{vue,ts,js,json,css}" "tests/*.mjs" "scripts/*.mjs" "web/*.html" vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json "docs/*.md" README.md THIRD_PARTY.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.{vue,ts,js,json,css}" "tests/*.mjs" "scripts/*.mjs" "web/*.html" vite.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json "docs/*.md" README.md THIRD_PARTY.md
